liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (4 reviews): The opening Shakedown Street is singled out as a highlight; Weir's playing is exceptional and his downbeat sets the tone, rivaling the 6-30-85 version [11][12][13][18]
- **Might As Well** (2 reviews): Closed the first set; Garcia's vocals avoid the lyric miscues heard in nearly every other song [18][20]
- **Standing On The Moon** (2 reviews): Garcia's happiness over his marriage comes through in this performance; Garcia's guitar work shines, showing the song's full potential to the reviewer [10][12]
- **El Paso** (1 other source): Weir plays acoustic guitar and does the song justice [7]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer calls the China Cat > Rider one of the better late-era versions, with extra spark from Garcia [20]
- **Women Are Smarter** (1 review): Decent version that builds strongly toward the end [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **Might As Well**: back after 193 archived shows (1010 days) [21]

## The recordings

- **gd94-03-23.naks.ladner.14257.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is somewhat thin but clear for an audience tape; Garcia's voice sounds exceptional [17]
- **gd94-03-23.sbd-aud.herman.13793.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 145 min; rated 3.27/5 by 11 [2]. Said about its sound: The matrix recording is very good; First set sounds great; second set comes from an audience source [9][15]
- **gd1994-03-23.139365.sbd.ebel.flac1644**: soundboard; 17 songs; 141 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd1994-03-23.134816.soundcheck_nak300guns.flac16**: source not stated; 5 songs; 21 min [8]

## Around the show

- Garcia had recently married Deborah Koons, who accompanied him on the tour [10]
- The first set circulates on eBay under the title "Broken Promises" [11]
- Nassau is hard to reach and poorly ventilated, but the lot's heavy-handed security had eased [18]
- Release includes soundcheck takes of Might As Well, Chord School and Corrina [7]
- Taper's friend worked for the Islanders, getting them into the coliseum early and up to the owners box [8]
- Soundcheck includes three Might As Well takes, Chord School and Corrina [8]
- Reviewer ranks the playing among the weaker 1994 shows, despite a strong setlist [9]
- Reviewer says only 3-20-91 might surpass this Might As Well [12]
- Notes say the previous Might As Well was 06-17-91 [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-03-23.naks.ladner.14257.shnf**: transferred by JA BUZZ and Chris Larson; source: Audience: Naks, model unknown [1]
- **gd94-03-23.sbd-aud.herman.13793.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 1: SBD DAT>WAV>CE>CDWAV>SHNSet 2: AUD DAT ( Nakamichi CM300's w/Cp4 shotguns>Denon DTR- 80P)>WAV>CE>CDWAV>SHNsubmitted by M.Walker via Steve Herman [2]
- **gd1994-03-23.139365.sbd.ebel.flac1644**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: Soundboard-> DAT [5]. Also: Soundboard captured with Schoeps CMC521 mics through a Sonosax preamp onto a Sony D10 Pro II; Fade out after Women Are Smarter and fade in on So Many Roads, for smoother CD playback [5]
- **gd1994-03-23.134816.soundcheck_nak300guns.flac16**: taped by Ted Cappelen; transferred by Ted Cappelen; source: Source: NAK300 Guns > Shure FP32 > Sony D7; Location: Center Ice Owners Box; [8]. Also: Soundcheck captured with NAK 300 guns set up from the owners box area [8]
